note: One place for what the user knows about the site and the market: the efficiency and capacity of the equipment, the price of energy and water, and the conversions from simulated dry matter to marketable units. Nothing here is a model value and nothing is assumed: every field is empty until the user defines it, and a result that needs an empty field is reported as not computable. The equipment and the electricity tariff can also be given per request in the bench; the water and heating prices and the conversions live here. Save changes from the bench (Resources) or edit this file.

meanings.heating_efficiency: thermal kW delivered per kW of input energy (boiler efficiency or heat-pump COP)
meanings.cooling_cop: thermal kW removed per electric kW
meanings.heating_energy: price of the heating fuel; empty: heating is priced with the electricity tariff
meanings.water: price per cubic metre of irrigation water (1 mm over 1 m2 is 1 litre); flat_per_m3 and/or a table per calendar year
meanings.fruit_dry_matter_fraction: dry-matter share of the fresh marketable product (0-1), to turn simulated dry matter into kg of fresh product; calibre and quality are not modelled
